_: Files that are meant to say the same thing in both apps. `npm run drift`
compares each against its twin in the sibling repository and fails if one
has moved without the other.
A file belongs here when the two copies are the same CODE — the same
component, the same rules — even where the wording around it differs.
Differences the two apps are entitled to (their names, their nouns) go in
`substitutions`: each pair folds the second spelling onto the first before
comparing, so a deliberate difference is written down once rather than
rediscovered every time somebody reads the diff.
A file NOT listed here is free to differ. That is the normal case: most of
each app is its own.
An entry marked `"code": true` is compared with its comments stripped. Those
files are the same component but explain themselves to each app's own
reader — Oyun's draft-keeping talks about a letter to the baby, Ìdílé's
about a letter to a child — and both are right.
The checker and this manifest are themselves on the list. A rule that
only one side is enforcing is not a rule.
One pair lives under two names: the reminder rules are lib/reminders.ts
in Ìdílé and lib/nudges.ts in Oyun, because each file is named for what
its own app calls the thing. `pair` names both.
